name: subagentify
description: Plans split into subagents with an explicit model: Opus for judgment, Sonnet for well-specified work. Adds the rule to the system prompt and fills in any subagent spawned without one.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Add the planning rule to the system prompt and route subagent models. Off: both hooks pass through.

classifyFallback.title: Classify when no model is given
classifyFallback.description: A subagent spawned without Opus or Sonnet is classified by a small model as an Opus or Sonnet task. Off: it gets the default model.

defaultModel.title: Default model
defaultModel.description: Model for a subagent that names none, when classification is off or fails.
